name: IRRBB NMD Shock and Basis Risk Check
outcome: Check interest rate risk in the banking book in three independent runs plus a session receipt: map non-maturity deposit balances into a bucketed net repricing gap schedule under a caller-declared behavioral allocation (ART-442), sweep the prescribed parallel shock ladder over that schedule and name the binding rung (ART-369), then run the basis-risk calculation at the binding rung cited from the ladder run (ART-443), closing with a session receipt aggregating the run's execution hashes (CRY-05). All balances, allocations, betas, and gaps are caller-supplied inputs; each run is an independent recompute from its own declared inputs. This chain is an analytical check, not a regulatory filing and not a capital adequacy determination.
